title: Pelukan Malam di Bioskop Tua
theme: Menemukan ketenangan dan makna mendalam dalam rutinitas malam yang sepi, di tengah kenangan masa lalu yang menghidupkan kembali semangat.

cover.prompt: Cinematic photography of the grand exterior of the Majestic Theater in the late evening. The architectural details are highlighted by a mellow glow from the street lamps and a soft, ambient light spilling from within the building. The city street is quiet, enveloped in a serene, gentle illumination, conveying a tranquil and reflective atmosphere. The composition emphasizes the impressive scale of the cinema against the calm surroundings, with a focus on depth and subtle details of the building's facade. A sense of lingering presence and peaceful solitude is central.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm and cool color grading

meta.plan_summary: A nocturnal cleaner at an old, majestic cinema discovers an old movie ticket, triggering a reflective journey through personal memories of love and family within the same theater. He finds peace and a deeper appreciation for his routine, transforming his workplace into a sanctuary of reflection.
